seoDescription: A longer biography of Ojobo Agbo Eje and his work across AI, data, research, and platform development.
text_003: My career connects technical work, applied research, and the organizational questions that decide whether technology changes anything meaningful.
text_005: Analytics and business intelligence for clearer decisions.
text_007: Applied data science in consequential settings.
text_009: Strategy, capability, and useful technical systems.
text_011: I began with engineering, analytics, and business intelligence: building ways to understand operational information and use it to make better decisions. That foundation still shapes how I approach AI—through evidence, systems, and the needs of the people using them.
text_013: My work expanded into data science, visualization, and research across healthcare, public policy, community development, and AI readiness. Those settings reinforced a practical lesson: a technically impressive model is not enough if its output is not understandable or usable.
text_016: This biography is a working draft. I will continue refining the details and chronology with verified career information.
